Container.Name: portabase-agent
Container.Overview:
Portabase Agent is the lightweight execution agent for Portabase. It connects to the Portabase Dashboard and executes database backup and restore tasks for configured database connections.
An EDGE_KEY generated by the Portabase Dashboard is required to authenticate the agent.
SECURITY: Keep EDGE_KEY confidential. Anyone possessing this key may be able to authenticate as the associated agent.
NETWORK: The agent does not require an exposed web port. Ensure that it can reach the Portabase Dashboard over HTTPS and the database servers it is configured to manage.
For Docker databases, use a shared Docker network or an appropriate host-reachable database address. Do not expose database ports publicly solely to make them accessible to this agent.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Portabase Agent Database Backup Restore PostgreSQL MariaDB MySQL
Container.Requires: A Portabase Dashboard instance and a valid EDGE_KEY generated for the agent. Network access to the Dashboard and configured database servers is required.

Config.Name: Edge Key
Config.Description: Required: paste the Edge Key generated by your Portabase Dashboard for this agent. Keep this value secret.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by Portabase Agent. Default: Europe/Paris.

Config.Name: Polling Interval
Config.Description: Interval between agent task checks, in seconds. Default: 5.

Config.Name: Agent Data
Config.Description: Persistent directory used by Portabase Agent for local data and agent-related files.

Config.Name: Agent Configuration
Config.Description: Optional directory for agent-side database configuration files. Dashboard-defined database connections may not require local configuration files.
